Game Launch Helper (replacement PC Bootstrapper), copied unchanged from
https://github.com/flarialmc/gamelaunchhelper at commit 7fc59f5755e3b9c9848f881ea6de6c8a276d6bf6.
The fork is GPLv3 (LICENSE-GPL.md); the original by Aetopia is MIT (LICENSE-MIT.md).
build-launcher compiles Library.c into gamelaunchhelper.dll and embeds it in MyClientLauncher.exe; after the
launcher installs a Minecraft version it writes the DLL into the game folder, like Flarial's launcher does.
